description.zh: 新的自定义属性描述，长度小于256个字符
description.en: The new description for the custom attribute. It must be 256 characters or less.
Whether to display the custom attribute in the UI.

description.zh: 新的自定义属性展示名称，长度小于128个字符
description.en: The new display name for the custom attribute. It must be 128 characters or less.

description.zh:
适用实体类型列表，支持精确实体类型以及 `*-table`、`*-column` 通配写法，如
- dataworks-project 工作空间
- dataworks-dataset dataworks数据集
- maxcompute-table maxcompute表
- *-column 所有字段类型
description.en:
The applicable entity types. This parameter supports specific types and wildcard formats, such as `*-table` and `*-column`. For example:

- `dataworks-project`: A DataWorks workspace

- `dataworks-dataset`: A DataWorks dataset

- `maxcompute-table`: A MaxCompute table

- `*-column`: All column types

description.zh: 是否支持作为筛选条件
description.en: Whether the custom attribute can be used as a filter condition.

description.zh: 枚举可选值，仅ENUM类型支持；更新时仅支持追加枚举值
description.en: The enumerated values. This applies only to custom attributes of the `enum` type. You can only append new values during an update.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public update-custom-attribute --id custom-attribute:biz_owner --display-name '业务负责人' --entity-types maxcompute-table --value-enums VALUE_1 --display-enabled true --search-filter-enabled false --comment test_comment --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dataworks-public UpdateCustomAttribute --region cn-hangzhou --EntityTypes 'maxcompute-table' --Comment test_comment --SearchFilterEnabled false --DisplayName '业务负责人' --ValueEnums VALUE_1 --Id 'custom-attribute:biz_owner' --DisplayEnabled true
